$comment: ADR-0073. Incidents only: content PRs merge with a merge commit, not a squash. Each entry lets scripts/verify-content.mjs judge a squash-merge by the commits of its pre-squash head, and only after checking that the head is present, that its content/ tree is identical to the squash's, and that its own commits pass every separation-of-duties rule. Every key is required and no other key is allowed.
